text:
maria: Heads up — LumenPath (POC) just sent over a CAIQ v4 and a spreadsheet. They want answers by EOD Friday. Can someone pick this up? Contact: emily@lumenpath.com. Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/LumenPath_CAIX_2026. Also note they asked about dedicated instance pricing for HIPAA workloads and data residency options.

dylan: I can triage. Quick Q: Is the initial POC on hosted or are they asking for Dedicated right away?

maria: Sales note: POC kicks off next week on hosted API, but customer may require Dedicated if ePHI is in scope. They marked HIPAA and SOC2 as must-haves. POC load: ~500k tokens/day; latency target ~150ms p50.

sachin: Assigning CAIQ responses to me. I'll need the model list, certs, and any BAA draft. @maria can you drop NDA/BAA into the folder and confirm signatory?

maria: NDA + preliminary BAA upload done (sheet name: LumenPath_NDA_BAA_2026.pdf). Tagging @jess for infra sizing.

jess: Got it — we'll validate whether Dedicated is required. For now, flag data residency: EU + US required. Also need their data flow diagram.

dylan: Target timeline: initial CAIQ draft by Wed EOD, internal review Thu, send to customer Fri. We can provide redacted SOC2 Type II and a summary of pentest cadence. KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys in Redwood Private / VPC.

maria: Customer also asked about log access for debugging and retention — any standard response?

sachin: Standard response: we provide scoped debugging access, logs are redacted of PII by default, retention follows the customer's contract; pentests annually + continuous vuln scanning. I'll craft the CAIQ text for those items.

maria: Emily also asked about penetration test reports and third-party vendor risk posture. Sending standard security whitepaper should be fine.

jess: One potential blocker: LumenPath wants full raw logs during POC to speed debugging. That conflicts with our PII/retention policy. Propose scoped access with data redaction or time-limited elevated access.

maria: Emily replied in thread — she's okay with redaction if we can provide a debugging path.

sig-bot: New CAIQ intake created — RI-CAIQ-2159876543 assigned to sachin. Due date auto-set to 2026-03-25.

sachin: I'll prepare the CAIQ answers and attach a redlined copy in Drive. @maria please confirm who from legal will review BAA.

maria: Looping in vendor-risk@redwood.com and legal for BAA signatory. Also requested data flow diagram from customer (asked for network + app layer flow).

emily (lumenpath): Thanks all — we can provide data flow diagram and confirm BAA signatory. Confirming POC duration: 3 months. Also asked for a rough Dedicated pricing estimate for budgeting.

lena: Rough ballpark for a 3-month Dedicated HIPAA POC (2x A100 equivalent, support): ~ $120k committed. I'll follow up with a formal quote and pricing sheet.

dylan: Ownership recap: sachin = CAIQ responses; jess = infra sizing & residency; lena = pricing/quote; maria = sales/customer comms. Noting a blocker around raw log access — will need a scoped solution. Marking high priority.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll update the CRM: CAIQ intake created, customer waiting on pricing and BAA. Will update progress and ping if blockers surface. :thumbsup:

emily (lumenpath): Appreciate it — please include a contact for deployment engineer during POC (for debugging calls).

jess: Assigning a deployment engineer once infra plan is confirmed.

sachin: Will upload CAIQ draft to Drive by Wed morning and request internal review.

maria: Perfect. Closing loop for now — will post final links here once submitted.
